newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway Oct CPI up 0.4 pct mo/mo.
newsitem.headline: Norway Oct CPI up 0.4 pct mo/mo.

text.p: Statistics Norway issued the following economic indicator.
NORWAY CONSUMER PRICES OCT 1996 SEPT 1996 OCT 1995
NOTE -- Economists forecast a year-on-year rise in October of 1.5 percent.
The statistics office attributed the month-on-month rise mainly to higher prices for energy products, including electricity and petrol.
Electricity prices for households rose 3.4 percent from September to October and nearly 14.0 percent on a yearly basis.
Petrol prices went up 3.2 percent on the average between September and October largely because prices were normalised following strong competition in southeast Norway earlier this autumn.
